name: Telegram Drive
description: A self-hosted, Google-Drive-style file manager backed by your own Telegram account. Made by ~Euthle (@euthle).

SECRET_KEY.description: Long random string used to sign sessions/CSRF tokens and to derive the encryption key for stored Telegram credentials.

TELEGRAM_API_ID.description: Optional: pre-fill the Telegram setup form. Get one free at https://my.telegram.org.

MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB.description: Maximum upload size per file, in MB.
